units.source_text: 房檐的柱子投下了淡淡的影子，不知不觉地已近黄昏。

en.t: The pillars under the eaves cast faint shadows, and before anyone knew it, dusk was already drawing near.

units.source_text: 没有什么可观赏的，于是岛村又乘火车来到了另一个镇子。

en.t: There was nothing to see, so Shimamura took the train again and went to another town.

units.source_text: 那里也和先前那个镇子不相上下。

en.t: That place, too, was much the same as the town before.

units.source_text: 岛村在那里也只是悠然漫步，然后吃了一碗面条，暖和暖和身子而已。

en.t: There too, Shimamura merely strolled about at leisure, then ate a bowl of noodles just to warm himself.
